name: timesfm
description: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting.
one_liner: A pretrained AI model that predicts future numbers in a time series — like tomorrow's sales, next week's server load, or next month's demand — without needing to train a custom model from scratch.
buyer: A retail or logistics operations manager who currently forecasts demand or inventory in spreadsheets and wants materially better predictions without hiring a data-science team.
business_use_cases: A mid-size retailer forecasts SKU-level demand for inventory planning instead of relying on gut-feel spreadsheets.
A SaaS company forecasts server load and cloud spend a month out to right-size infrastructure budgets.
A logistics company predicts shipping-lane volume to plan staffing and truck capacity ahead of demand spikes.

money_ideas.idea: Build a plug-and-play 'demand forecasting' SaaS for small-to-mid retailers that connects to their sales data and outputs a forecast dashboard.
Offer forecasting-as-a-service consulting: plug this model into a client's historical data for a one-off inventory or staffing forecast report.

steal_this: This weekend, pull a public retail or e-commerce sales dataset, run it through the model, and build a simple dashboard demo to pitch to a local retailer as a paid pilot.
